page_title: ALM 2-2 ATM | Almeria v Atletico Madrid 24/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Javier Alberola Rojas is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he sends his effort over the crossbar.
90+3' This is a yellow card! Adrian Embarba (Almeria) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
90+3' Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Almeria in a dangerous position.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
88' A player from Atl. Madrid commits an attacking foul. The referee blows his whistle.
85' Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
82' Dion Lopy (Almeria) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Lucas Robertone.
82' The game has come to an end for Rodrigo de Paul. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Axel Witsel (Atl. Madrid).
81' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
78' Gaizka Garitano decides to make a substitution. Jonathan Viera will be replaced by Gonzalo Melero (Almeria).
78' Substitution. Choco Lozano makes way for Leo Baptistao (Almeria).
77' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak easily deals with the threat.
74' Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Atl. Madrid have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.
70' Angel Correa comes off the pitch to be replaced by Saul Niguez (Atl. Madrid).
69' Gaizka Garitano prepares a substitution. Aleksandar Radovanovic is replaced by Chumi (Almeria).
69' The referee signals a substitution. Alvaro Morata (Atl. Madrid) is brought on as a substitute for Memphis Depay.
69' Here comes a substitution. Sergio Arribas (Almeria) is brought on as a substitute for Luka Romero.
68' The ball is cleared after Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
67' Luka Romero (Almeria) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
64' 2 - 2 Luka Romero (Almeria) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the top right corner of the net.
63' None of the Atl. Madrid players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.

63' That was absolutely fantastic! Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid) tries his luck with a hammer shot from long range, but his effort only rattles the crossbar! Here is an example of luck not being on your side.
62' Almeria can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
60' Almeria take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
57' 1 - 2 Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) has a great chance inside the box and puts the ball into the back of the net.
54' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
52' Javier Alberola Rojas interrupts the game. One of the players from Atl. Madrid won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Almeria will take a free kick.
50' Marcos Llorente (Atl. Madrid) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Luis Maximiano was alert and made a comfortable save.

48' Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid) produces a shot from a direct free kick on the edge of the box. His effort sails narrowly over the crossbar. The goalkeeper was lucky there. The ball goes out of play and Almeria will have a goal kick.
47' A player from Almeria commits a rough challenge. Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. Atl. Madrid have a free kick from a promising distance.
46' Here is a change. Samuel Lino is going off and Diego Simeone gives the last tactical orders to Rodrigo Riquelme (Atl. Madrid).
46' Diego Simeone has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Marcos Llorente comes on the pitch for Koke (Atl. Madrid).
46' Javier Alberola Rojas blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+3' The end of the first half.
45+2' The ball goes behind for a corner. Atl. Madrid will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
45+1' The fourth official shows 2 min. of added time.
44' Nahuel Molina (Atl. Madrid) attempts to find one of his teammates inside the box with a chip pass, but one of the defending players reacts superbly and intercepts the ball.
40' The referee is firm and issues Reinildo (Atl. Madrid) a deserved yellow card.
39' PENALTY APPEAL by Almeria, but the referee thinks it was a fair challenge and play continues!
36' Atl. Madrid concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Almeria are awarded the free kick.
34' Adrian Embarba (Almeria) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Jan Oblak intercepts the ball.
32' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Atl. Madrid.

32' Samuel Lino (Atl. Madrid) wastes an opportunity. He finds himself in acres of space and fires in a terrific shot from long range straight towards the bottom left corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
30' A corner kick by Atl. Madrid is thwarted by the well prepared Luis Maximiano (Almeria).
29' The resulting set piece from Atl. Madrid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

27' 1 - 1 What a beautiful moment! Luka Romero (Almeria) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Jan Oblak just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 1:1.
23' Pablo Barrios (Atl. Madrid) produces a good strike that sails to the middle of the goal, but his low effort ends up in the goalkeeper's gloves.
22' A cross from Adrian Embarba (Almeria) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
21' Choco Lozano (Almeria) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the bottom left corner, but Jan Oblak was alert and made a comfortable save.
19' Atl. Madrid seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
18' Luka Romero (Almeria) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
15' Marc Pubill (Almeria) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
13' One of the players from Atl. Madrid times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
11' Atl. Madrid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
10' What a huge chance for Memphis Depay (Atl. Madrid). He collects a precise pass inside the box and slices a shot that goes a whisker wide of the left post.
9' Luka Romero (Almeria) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
8' Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
7' Rodrigo de Paul (Atl. Madrid) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Luis Maximiano.
5' The ball is behind the touchline and Atl. Madrid will take a throw-in.
2' 0 - 1 Angel Correa (Atl. Madrid) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Almeria will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
